table.name: TLGNC_MOPEVENT_HEADER_OUT
table.description: Contains the base information of a Message sent from Logon to MOP. These fields either exist in all event types or are set to null where not applicable.

column.name: EVENT_NAME
column.description: Name of the event, that will be called. Event names are e.g.: login, changePIN, logout, ...

column.name: SENDER_TIME
column.description: Date and time of the sending device.

column.name: SESSION_NO
column.description: Session identifier, valid after sucessfull login.

column.name: MOP_STATUS_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_mop_status_bs. Contains a status-code and status-text about the executed event. Used as WebService response

column.name: MOP_STATUS_CONTEXT_VALUE
column.description: additional status-text.e.g.on status 0/Mandatory Field Missing: there will be added a name.

column.name: NEEDS_RESENDING_FLAG
column.description: Flag to say if the event must be resent. Flags is set if a) the Com-Server is not available (=technical error) or b) the PDA is not available (response code 20301).
